headline: Jabil Stock Jumps After Issuing Amazon a Warrant for $160 Million of Shares
summary:
Jabil stock rose Friday after the company granted warrants to Amazon com that entitle it to buy more than one million shares for about $160 million. Jabil stock was up 3.9% to $148.46 on the news, while Amazon.com shares had gained 1.8% to $224.18. Contract manufacturer Jabil issued Amazon a warrant to buy 1,158, 539 Jabil shares at an initial exercise price of $137.7671, according to a form it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
